vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM snehakalpanAM darSayannAha - kalkAditi | anukte kalkAtkalkayogadravyAt GRutaM tailaM vA caturguNaM grAhyaM, na tu dRuShadi peShitAtkalkAt| dravamapi caturguNaM snehaparimANAt dravaM toyAdi | tasya mAtrA palonmiteti | tasya saMsiddhasnehasya pAnArthaM palonmitA palapramANA mAtrA j~jeyA ityanukteShu mAnamidaM sAmAnyaM | pariBAShAyAmayamapi sAmAnyasnehapAkavidhau boddhavyaH, tathAhi - `kalkAccaturguNaH snehaH snehAtkvAthaScaturguNaH | kvAthAccaturguNaM vAri kvAthaH kvAthyasamo mataH' iti | viSeSho~api kvacidvartate yathA tantrAntare vAsAGRute balAdye GRute vA tadyathA -``atrApyaShTaguNaistoyaiH kvathitaM kvAthadugdhayoH | pratyekaM dviguNo BAgo BiShak sarpiShi nikShipet'' iti || 1 || 2||

gU0 - atha sneheti | tatra tAvat prathamataH pariBAShAmasya vyAcaShTe | atha GRutAdhikAraH | tatrAdau GRutatailAdisAdhanamAha - tatkalketyAdi | kalkAt dravyAt GRutaM tailaM caturguNe dravye dugdhAdau sAdhyam agnidvArA kaTAhAdau paktvA siddhaM Bavati | tasya mAtrA vAtAdirogaviShaye mAnamAtrA palonmitA palapramANA | idAnIM snehasAdhane kvAthavidhAnamAha - nikShipyetyAdi | kvAthadravyAccaturguNaM toyaM jalaM nikShipya kvAthayet| punaH pAdaSiShTaM ca caturthAMSAvaSeShaM gRuhItvA~anena kvAthena snehaM GRutaM tailaM vA sAdhayet | kvAthaM kvAthayogyaM kuTTitaM yaddravyaM daSamUlAdi tasmAdisyarthaH || 1 || 2 ||

pada: navamo~adhyAyaH | atha snehapariBAShA | kalkAccaturguNIkRutya GRutaM vA tailameva vA | caturguNe drave sAdhyaM tasya mAtrA palonmitA ||1|| nikShipya kvAthayettoyaM kvAthyadravyAccaturguNam | pAdaSiShTaM gRuhItvA ca snehaM tenaiva sAdhayet ||2||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM dravyaviSeShe kvAthanimittaM jalamAnamAha - caturguNamiti | atra caturguNapraBRutikaM dravyaparimANAddhoddhavyam | yAvatparimANaM kvAthyaM dravyaM Bavati tAvatparimANAccaturguNitaM jalaM grAhyamityarthaH | mRudu kaThinaM kaThinataraM ca dravyaM tatraivAnumAnato~avagantavyam | tathAca madhyame dravye dadyAdaShTaguNaM paya iti | madhyame mRudvAdisaMBAre payaH pAnIyaM yatra mRudukaThinataradravyamekatra militvA kvAthyaM tatrAShTaguNaM pAnIyaM datvA pAdaSeShaM grAhyamiti sarvatra | tathAhi - `mRudvAdikvAthyasaMGAte mAnAnukte cikitsakAH | madhyasyoBayaBAgitvAdicCantyaShTaguNaM jalam' iti || 3 ||

gU0 - mRududravye guDUcyAdau caturguNaM jalaM, kaThine daSamUlAdau aShTaguNaM, tathAca madhyamadravye AragvadhAdau aShTaguNaM payaH | payo~atra jalaM | atyantakaThine padmakAdau ShoDaSikaM ShoDaSaguNaM mataM kathitaM caturthAMSaM gRuhyate || 3 ||

pada: mRududravyAdau kvathane jalapramANamAha - caturguNaM mRududravye kaThine~aShTaguNaM jalam | tathAca madhyame dravye dadyAdaShTaguNaM payaH || 3 || atyantakaThine dravye nIraM ShoDaSikaM matam |

vya_text: dI0 - karShAdita iti | karShAdita ityAdiparimANaM sAmAnyadravyaviShaye vartate anyathA svatantravirodhaH, yAva- tkvAthyadravyaM karShAdiparimANAtpalaM Bavati tAvattatra ShoDaSAMSaM jalaM datvA kvAthaM pAdaSeShaM grAhyaM | ShoDaSikamatra kvAthyadravyaparimANAt, tatastu palAdupari yAvatkuDavaM kvAthyadravyaparimANaM Bavati tAvadatra toyaM pAnIyamaShTaguNaM Bavet, kvAthyadravyAdityarthaH | atra kvAthaM caturthAMSaM grAhyamiti sarvatra | prasthAdita iti | prasthAdiparimANAt yAvat KArI Bavati tAvadatra caturguNaM nIraM pAnIyaM prakShipya saMkvAthya ca pAdaSeShaM grAhyamiti tAtparyArthaH | AdiSabdAt ADhakadroNaSUrpadroNIpraBRutayo grAhyAH | yadvA prasthasyAdiH prasthAdistasmAt tena SarAvamapi gRuhyate, SarAvAdita ityarthaH || 4 || 5 ||aparamapyanuktamAha - ambukvAtheti | yatra snehapAke pAnIyAditrayANAM dravyANAM madhye yadA ekena pAkaH syAt tadA kalkasya kalkadravyasya caturthAMSaM ShaShThAMSam aShTamAMSaM yathA~anukrameNa deyam | anukramo yathA - yadi ambunA kevalena pAkastarhi kalkadravyasya caturthASaM deyam, snehaparimANAdityarthaH | yadA kevalena kvAthenaiva pAkastadA kalkadravyasya ShaShThAMSaM deyam, atrApi snehaparimANAdityarthaH | yatra tu kevalasvarasenaiva sAdhyate srehaH tatra kalkadravyasyAShTamAMSaM deyam | snehamAnAdityatrApi sambandhaH ityanukramaH | aparamapi - dugdhe ityatrApi ekadravyasAdhyatA sUcyate tadA kalkadravyaM snehaparimANAdaShTamAMSaM deyamiti BAvaH | kalkasyeti | yatra tu anyadravaiH kevalakalkenaiva sAdhyate snehastadA caturguNaM kalkadravyaM caturguNaM toyaM nikShipediti sarvatra | samyak pAkArthaM boddhavyam | etena kimuktaM yadA kShIrAdiBiH pratyekena svakalkena pAkastadA caturguNaM caturthAMSaM pAnIyaM deyam | pAnIyaM vinA pAko nAstIti sarvamatam || 6 || 7 ||

gU0 - karShAdAraBya KArIparyantaM kvAthyadravye jalamAnamAha - karShAditaH yAvatpalaM pramANaM tAvat ShoDaSikaM ShoDaSaguNaM jalaM kShipet| tadUrdhvaM palAdUrdhvaM yAvatkuDavaM kuDavapramANaM tAvadaShTaguNaM payo jalaM Bavet | prasthAditaH yAvat KArIpramANaM tAvaccaturguNaM jalaM kShipet | pUrvaM caturguNAdijalaM yalliKitaM tanmRududravyAdiviShayaM j~jeyaM | karShAdita idaM tu mAnaviShayam ataH kecinmRudvAdito gRuhNanti kecinmAnato gRuhNanti || 4 || 5|| ambvAdiBiryatra snehamAnaM tatra kalkapramANamAha - `tatrAmbupiShTamuktaM syAjjalaM cAtra caturguNam', yatra BinnaM sAdhanaM Bavati, tatra kalkasyAMSaM caturguNaM ShaShThaM kramAt ambupAke caturthAMSaM raso mAMsarasastatpAke aShTamAMSam | ukto~apyambvAdau pAke dugdhAdau aShTamAMSa eva kalkapAka ityAha - kalkasya samyagiti | dugdhe tathA dadhni tathA takre pAkAnantaraM kalkaH aShTamAMSakAdayaH raso mAMsarasaH | yadvA raso dhattUrarasaH mAMsarasasya pUrvoktatvAt kalkasya samyak pAkArthaM caturguNaM snehAdityarthaH || 6 || 7 ||

pada: atha matAntare parimANaviSeShamAha - karShAditaH palaM yAvatkShipetShoDaSikaM jalam || 4 || tadUrdhvaM kuDavaM yAvadBavedaShTaguNaM payaH | prasthAditaH kShipennIraM KArI yAvaccaturguNam || 5 || ambukvAtharasairyatra pRuthaksnehasya sAdhanam | kalkasyAMSaM tatra dadyAccaturthaM ShaShThamaShTamam || 6 || dugdhe dadhni rase nakre kalko deyo~aShTamAMSakaH | kalkasya samyakpAkArthaM toyamatra caturguNam || 7 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnImanuktadravANAM mAnamAha - davANIti | yatra snehapakvadravANi kShIratakrarasamUtrakvAthAni anyAnyapi pa~jcAdIni pa~jcapraBRutIni Bavanti anuktamAnAnIti viShayaH | tatra tAni dravANi snehasamAni pratyekamAhurAcAryAH | yathA vakShyamANatriPalAGRute arvAk dravaM catvArastrayo vA tarhi snehaparimANAccaturguNaM j~jeyaM pratyekamityarthaH | eke yathApUrvaM caturguNamiti paThanti tatrApi sa evArthaH | kutracit dravyANIti pATho dRuSyate so~asa~ggata eva || 8 ||

gU0 - dravyANIti | yatra pa~jcAdhikAni dravyANi tatra sneheShu kiyatparimitaM dravyaM deyaM tadAha - sneheShu GRutatailAdiShu dravANi dugdhAdIni yatra pa~jcapraBRutIni Bavanti tatra snehasamAnaM Bavati na caturguNAnIti yAvat | yathApUrvaM caturguNamityetasyAyamartha: | eko dravastatra pAkena cAturguNyaM, dvau dravau yatra tatra dvAByAM cAturguNyaM yaduktaM jaijjaTe `ekadvitridravairdravyaiH kuryAt snehAccaturguNaM | kShIraM snehasamaM dadyAt caturBiSca caturguNam, iti | asyAyamarthaH yatraiko dravastatraikena cAturguNyaM, evaM dvAByAM, triBirmilitvA cAturguNyamityarthaH | yatra pa~jcAdhikAni Bavanti tatra snehasamAnIti pUrvArthaH| `tailasyArdhapramANena dadyAdikShurasaM budhaH | tathA mAMsarasaM cArdhaM datvA snehaM vipAcayet' snehasamAnyAhurityasya truTimAhurityarthaH ityanye | tadyathA - sakRunmAMsauShadhirasaM mUtrasauvIrakAdikaM | snehatulyaM dadhi kShIraM jalaM caiva caturguNam || granthaj~jAnArthamedvyavAKyAprasa~ggenoktam ||8||

pada: dravANi yatra sneheShu pa~jcAdIni Bavanti hi | tatra snehasamAnyAhuryathApUrvaM caturguNam || 8 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha kevaladravyasya snehapAkArthaM mAnamAha - dravyeNeti | atra dravyaM snehAccaturthAMSaM kalkArthaM vAri tAvaddeyaM yAvat kalkaH syAt | yataH peShaNe jalasya parimANaM na syAt | jalaM cAtra caturguNamiti | atra kalke jalaM pAnIyam | caturguNaM deyaM snehamAnAdityarthaH | eke dravyamAnAccaturguNaM jalamiti vyAKyAnayanti tanna manoharaM kalkadravyAlpatvAt | aparamapyAha - kvAtheneti | yatra snehe kvaciditi anukte kevalena kvAthena kRutvA pAkaH kathitaH tatra snehe kvAthyadravyasya kalka: kAryaH, kalkArthaM cAtra caturguNaM jalamiti tena yenaiva dravyeNa kvAthaH kriyate tainaiva tatparimitena ca dravyeNAyamapi kRutvA~atra caturguNena ca jalena saha sAdhyaH | pUrvaM kvAthena sAdhyaH paScAtkalkenetyarthaH ||9||10||
gU0 - kevalena kvAthena yadi snehapAko Bavet tatrAmbupiShTaH kalko jalaM caturguNakvAtheneti | idaM padyaM pUrvaSlokasyaikArthatvAt prakShiptaM j~jeyaM || 9 || 10 ||

pada: kevalakvAthapAke vidhAnamAha - dravyeNa kevalenaiva snehapAko Bavedyadi | tatrAmbupiShTaH kalkaH syAjjalaM cAtra caturguNam || 9|| kvAthena kevalenaiva pAko yatreritaH kvacit | kvAthyadravyasya kalko~api tatra snehe prayujyate ||10||

vya_text: dI0 - kalkahIna iti | yaH sneho GRutaM tailAdikaH kalkahInaH kalkarahito Bavet saH kevale drave sAdhyaH| dravamatra caturguNaM snehaparimANAt ||
gU0 - atha kevaladravasAdhanamAha - kalkahIne snehe sAdhanamAha - yaH kalkahInaH snehaH sa kevale drave sAdhyaH|

pada: kalkahInastu yaH srehaH sa sAdhyaH kevale drave |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM puShpakalkasya parimANamAha puShpakalka iti | yaH puShpakalkasaMj~jaH snehaH tatra snehe toyaM pAnIyaM caturguNaM deyaM caturguNatA ca snehAt snehaparimANAdityarthaH | saH puShpakalkaH snehAShTamAMSo yojyata ityarthaH | snehasyAShTamAMSaM tena sAmyo yojya ityarthaH | puShpANi yathA nAgakeSaraku~gkumalava~ggadamanakasurapuShpacampakotpalapuNDarIkaketakIjAtI-kusumBapraBRutIni | eke puShpakalkaH prayujyata ityasya sthAne~atra kalkaM prayujyate iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti tat patrakalkaM prakShepamAhuH, tathAhi - `gandhaniryAsapuShpANAM siddhaSIte~avatArite | prakShepo gandhavRuddhyarthaM patrakalkaM tu tadviduH' || 11 ||

gU0 - puShpakalkai: snehasAdhanamAha - puShpeti | yasminsnehe puShpakalko dIyate sa puShpakalkaH snehaH, tatra toyaM jalaM caturguNaM snehAtpuShpakalkaH kiyatparimito dIyate ityatrAha - snehAShTamAMSaSca puShpakalkaH prayujyate iti || 11 ||

pada: puShpakalkastu yaH snehastatra toyaM caturguNam || 11 || snehe snehAShTamAMSaSca puShpakalkaH prayujyate |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM snehAnAM saMsiddhilakShaNAnyAha - vartivaditi | yadA snehe paripAcitaH kalkaH a~ggulyA vimardito vartisadRuSo Bavati tadA siddho j~jeyaH | athavA sa eva kalkaH yadA~agnau nikShiptaH Sabdarahito Bavati tadA siddho j~jAtavyaH iti sAmAnyam | aparamapi viSeShamAha - yadA snehasya pAkAnte taile Penodgamo Bavati sarpiShi ca PenaSAntirBavati tadA siddhalakShaNaM boddhavyaM | varNagandharasotpattirapi snehasiddhiH syAt varNAdikamapi taile sarpiShi ca j~jAtavyam | adhunA trividhasnehapAkasya lakShaNamAha - IShatsarasakalka iti | yadA kalke sAndratA ki~jcidBavati agnau nikShipte sati caTacaTASabdo Bavati tadA mRudupAko j~jeyaH, yadA nIraso kalko Bavati komalaSca nAtikaThino nAtimRuduriti tadA madhyapAkaH, yadA ki~jcit kaThinakalko jAtaH nIrasaSca Bavati tadA KarapAka iti | eteShAM parIkShaNamanumAnato~avagantavyaM gurusakASadarSanAdvA | tadUrdhvaM KarapAkAdUrdhvaM yadA snehakalkaH kaThinataro Bavati tadA dagdho j~jeyaH, sa ca sarvakarmasu niShPalaH syAt dAhakaraSca Bavati ||12-16||

gU0 - idAnIM snehasiddhalakShaNamAha - yadA snehakalkaH a~ggulyA vartitaH vartIkRutaH vartivadBavet agninikShiptaH SabdahInaSca Bavet tadA siddhaM vadet | yadA varNagandharasotpattistadApi snehasiddhirBavet| iti ca lakShaNaM varNastailapakvavarNo raktAdiH, gandhaH sugandhatvaM, rasotpattirmadhurAdirasotpattiH, tadA svedanAllakShyate | snehapAkasya trividhatvamAha - eko mRudu:, eko madhyaH, ekaH KaraH; evaM tridhA snehapAkaH | teShAM lakShaNamAha - IShatsarasakalkaH IShajjalakalkaH mRudusnehapAkaH nIrasakomale kalke siddhaH pAko madhyapAkaH nIrasakomale jalasahite Ardre IShatkaThinakalkaH snehapAkaH KaraH tadUrdhvaM dagdhapAko dAhakRunniShprayojanaH, na kAryakArI ||12||16||

pada: vartivatsnehakalkaH syAdyadA~ggulyA vimarditaH ||12|| SabdahIno~agninikShiptaH snehaH siddho BavettadA| yadA Penodgamastaile PenaSAntiSca sarpiShi ||13|| gandhavarNarasotpattiH snehasiddhistadA Bavet | snehapAkastridhA prokto mRudurmadhyaH KarastathA ||14|| IShatsarasakalkastu snehapAko mRudurBavet | madhyapAkasya siddhiSca kalke nIrasakomalaH ||15|| IShatkaThinakalkaSca snehapAko BavetKaraH | tadUrdhvaM dagdhapAkaH syAddAhakRunniShprayojanaH || 16 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idrAnIM tasya caturvidhapAkasya guNamAha - AmapAkaSceti | AmapAko~aparipAkakalka: sneho nirvIryo Bavati, niHSeSheNa vIryarahita ityarthaH | vahnimAndyakRudBakShaNayoge ca Bavati | nasyaviShaye mRudupAkaH snehaH | madhyapAkastu sarvakarmasu yujyate sarvakarma nasyABya~ggapAnAdikaM | KarapAkasnehaH kevalABya~gge vihitaH nAnyakarmasu | yathocitamiti yathAyogyaM yuMjyAdityarthaH | eke nasyABya~gge KaraH prokta iti paThanti, tanna sarvasaMmatam, nasye tu saumyamAhuH | snehastu kimekAhenaiva sAdhyaH uta dIrGadavasaiH tadviShayamAha - GRuteti | GRutataile prasiddhe guDo~avalehaH | AdigrahaNAt IdRuSasamBArA ye cA~anye prayogAH te sarve ekasminneva vAsare na sAdhyA: na pAcanIyA ityarthaH | kutastadAha - prakurvanti ityAdi | te snehAdayastu yadA uShitAH santi tadA guNasa~jcayaM prakurvanti | ata eva bahudivasaiH kRutvA sAdhanIyA iti BAvaH | tantrAntareShu etadbahudravyasamBAraviShayam, asmatsampradAye~api svalpamapi snehaM ki~jci- dvipAcyApare~ahni siddho~avatAryaH guDAdikamapi cApare~ahni madhudAnAdikamuktaM kuryAt naivaM sarvamatavirodhaH || || 17 || 18 ||

gU0 - AmapAkastrividhapAkAddhInaH sajala evetyarthaH, sa vahnimAndyakaraH, tathA guruH | yeShu mRudvAdayaH prayujyante, tAnAha - nasyArthamiti | nasyArthaM mRudupAkaH sarvakarmasu, BakShaNAvasthAyAM madhyamaH, aBya~ggArthaM KaraH evaM yathocitaM yu~jjyAt prayojayet, GRutatailAdIn ekasminneva dine na sAdhayet, kutaH ? uShitA rAtrau vAsitA viSeShAdguNasa~jcayaM kurvanti || SAr~ggadharAnuktamapi tailasAdhanam AtreyAdAha - ``sneho vArisamaM nItvA pAcayet mRuduvahninA | pa~jcapallavakalkena dvAtriMSAMSena saMyutam || kiMcitsarasagarBeNa vastrapUtaM prakalpayet | itye- tadduShTagandhAdidoShastailAdvimucyate || nirdoShakaraNAdetatkRutvA tailaM vipAcayet'' iti | granthAntare evaM SodhanaM - ``tailaM kRutvA kaTAhe dRuDhataravimale mandamandAgninA ca pakvaM niShPenaBAvaM gatamiha hi yadA SaityaBAvaM tadaiva | mu~jjiShThArAtrilodhrairjaladharanalikaiH sAmalai: sAkShapathyaiH sUcIpuShpAvarohairnayati satataM gandhayogaM jahAti'' || ma~jjiShThAdyairmilitaiH agninIraiH pAdAMSakaiH kalkIkRutaiH pacet, rAtrirharidrA, jaladharo mustakaH, nalikA gandhanalikA uttaradeSe prasiddhA tadaBAve tvak; sAmalai: sAmalakaiH, akShaM biBItakaM, pathyA harItakI, sUcIpuShpaM ketakI, avarohaH vaTAvarohaH, cakArAt granthAntare caiva ``tailasyendukalAMSakena vikacA grAhyA tu mUrcCAvidhau ye cAnye triPalAdayastu rajanIhrIberalodhrAnvitAH | sUcIpuShpavaTAvarohanalikAdravyAstu pAdAMSikAH procyAstailajagandhadoShaharaNe kalkIkRutAstadvidaiH? | vikacA ma~jjiShThA, indukalAMSena tailAt ShoDaSAMSena grAhyAH, mUrcCAvidhau tailamUrcCAvidhau, ye cAnye triPalAdayaste militvA kalkIkRutAH | payodo mustA, rajanI haridrA, hrIbera udIcyaM, lodhraH prasiddhaH, sUcI- puShpaM ketakI, vaTAvarohaH, nalikA gandhanalikA, tathAca - `madhye sAravihInA ca sarasA kITavarjitA | nalikA sA BavedBadrA viparItA tu ninditA' | kecinnalikAM tvacamAhuH | iti GRutatailasAdhanaprakAraH || || 17 || 18 ||

pada: AmapAkaSca nirvIryo vahnimAndyakaro guru: | nasyArthaM stanmRudu: pAko madhyamaH sarvakarmasu ||17|| aBya~ggArthaM KaraH prokto yu~jjyAdevaM yathohitam | GRutatailaguDAdIMSca sAdhayennaikavAsare ||18|| prakurvantyuShitA hyete viSeShAdguNasaMcayam |

vya_text: dI0 - sa yathetyanena taM snehapAkasamUhaM darSayati granthakAraH | tatrAdau pUrvaM tAvadvRutakalpanAM darSayannAha yatastailAdviSiShTo GRutakalpaH pUrvAcAryairdarSitaH tathaivAtrApi liKitaH | prathamataH kShIraShaTpalakaGRutavyAKyAnamAha - pippalIti | atra pippalyAdikaM pa~jcadravyaM pa~jcakolasaMj~jaM boddhavyam, yatastantrAntare pa~jcakolaGRutamasya nAma prasiddham, atra cavyamiti viTapaviSeShaH, yasya PalaM gajapippalIti SrutiH, palikairiti palapramANatA pratyekamAhuH | ata eva kShIraShaTpalakaGRutamidam, caturguNakShIreNa saha ShaTpalapramANaShaDdravyaiSca sAdhitamityarthaH | atra caturguNaM nIramapi deyam, samyakpAkA- rthamityasmatsampradAyABiprAyaH | GRutaprasthamiti | ShoDaSapalamitam `kShIrasya caturguNatAtra GRutaparimANAt tatsiddhamiti siddhatA~asya pariBAShoktavidhAnAt ||19||20||
